intent: PSI-019: Implement Admin Groups, Roles, and Permissions pages.
summary: Built full administration interfaces for Groups (/dashboard/admin/groups), Roles (/dashboard/admin/roles), and Permissions (/dashboard/admin/permissions). Added Server Actions in features/admin/actions.ts for managing group memberships (with batch email pasting) and role permission matrices (with modular grouping and ungrantable checkbox protection). Verified with tsc, oxlint, next build, and pgTAP suite.

changes.note: Added GroupDetail, RoleDetail, and PermissionCatalogueItem types
Added Server Actions for Groups, Roles, and Permissions catalogue
Group management view with member & role editors
Role management view with module permission matrix

decisions.decision: Structure permission matrix by functional module (rbac, mail, agenda, etc.)
decisions.reason: Allows administrators to quickly configure capability groups without scanning a flat list of permissions.

decisions.decision: Disable permission checkboxes the user cannot grant
decisions.reason: Prevents unauthorized privilege escalation at the UI layer while RLS enforces it in the database.

verification.manual: Verified all 3 admin routes compiled and rendered in Next.js production build.

human_review.reason: Awaiting human operator review stamp on PSI-019 card.
